title: 1156-1158 East Rich Street (Houses), Columbus, Franklin County, OH
notes: Significance: The building contributes to the Near East Side Historic District, a predominately residential area containing those architectural styles typical of affluent neighborhoods from the 1880s to the 1930s. The Near East Side was one of the city's most fashionable residential areas at the end of the nineteenth century.
National Register of Historic Places NRIS Number: 78002063
